question: When should the ritual substance be consumed in relation to the yoginī assembly?
premises: This should be done at all times.
It is connected with the assembly of yoginīs.
inference: One should always drink that substance whenever there is an assembly of yoginīs.
uncertainties: The syntactic relation between sadā kālaṃ and yoginī melakaḥ bhavet is somewhat compressed.
plain_english: One should always drink that; whenever there is an assembly of yoginīs.
